verdict.rationale: Brex's own materials document spend limits with auto-enforced controls, vendor-specific cards with per-transaction limits, and monthly limits on cards and users that can reset each month, so the core of per-card and per-employee limits is supported. The 'granular controls for each employee' part is thin: the evidence never details per-employee control types beyond limits, and all support is marketing or integration-level claims. missing for 10: documented granular per-employee control types (e.g., merchant/category restrictions, per-employee policy configuration), in-depth first-party docs on per-card limit configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
